meaning:
Someone descended from Hachmon or Tahchemon(?), first mentioned at 2Sa.23.8; also called Tahchemonite (KJV: Tachmonite; NIV: Tahkemonite) at 2Sa.23.8;
Also named: tach.ke.mo.ni (תַּחְכְּמֹנִי "Tahchemonite" H8461)
§ Hachmoni or Hachmonite = "wise"
1) father of one of David's mighty warriors
2) father of the tutor of David's sons
n patr m
3) the family of one of David's servants

elsewhere.note: This is the number of the mighty men whom David had: Jashobeam, the son of a Hachmonite, the chief of the thirty; he lifted up his spear against three hundred…
